name: 1c-dev-rules
description: Универсальный подключаемый набор правил разработки 1С:Предприятие 8 на основе v8std. Скилы для написания и ревью кода: запросы, формы, метаданные, транзакции, производительность, чек-листы.
author: Roman
skillInstructions: Use the 1c-* skills for any 1C:Enterprise 8 (1С:Предприятие 8) development or code-review task: BSL code, queries, managed forms, metadata XML (.mdo/.form), transactions, extensions, reports (СКД), security/RLS, performance. Always open the 1c-dispatch-gate skill FIRST — it routes the task to the thematic skills and lists mandatory gate checks. After writing code, run the 1c-thin-triggers self-check and 1c-code-review. When creating or editing metadata objects, dogfood scripts/validate-new-object.sh on the object directory. Do not invent BSL API — verify functions exist in the project sources.
